import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

digits = load_digits()
X, y = digits.data / 16, digits.target
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
Y_train = np.eye(10)[y_train]

def softmax(Z):
    Z = Z - Z.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
    E = np.exp(Z)
    return E / E.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)


rng=np.random.default_rng(0);W1=rng.normal(size=(64,32))*.1;W2=rng.normal(size=(32,10))*.1;b1=np.zeros(32);b2=np.zeros(10)
for _ in range(300):
    Z1=X_train@W1+b1;H=np.maximum(0,Z1);P=softmax(H@W2+b2);D=(P-Y_train)/len(y_train);dH=D@W2.T*(Z1>0)
    gW2=H.T@D;gb2=D.sum(axis=0);gW1=X_train.T@dH;gb1=dH.sum(axis=0)
    W1-=.5*gW1;b1-=.5*gb1;W2-=.5*gW2;b2-=.5*gb2
own_proba=softmax(np.maximum(0,X_test@W1+b1)@W2+b2);acc_own=round(float((own_proba.argmax(axis=1)==y_test).mean()),3)
expect: Q1 решить own-net. Q2 опора: формула и заготовка этого урока. Q3 450×10 own_proba, все градиенты на старыхW2.

import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier

digits = load_digits()
X, y = digits.data / 16, digits.target
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)
model = MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,), alpha=1e-3, max_iter=500, random_state=0).fit(X_train, y_train)

def shift_right(X):
    imgs = np.roll(X.reshape(-1, 8, 8), 1, axis=2)
    imgs[:, :, 0] = 0
    return imgs.reshape(-1, 64)

X_fit, X_val, y_fit, y_val = train_test_split(X_train, y_train, test_size=0.25, random_state=7, stratify=y_train)


import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def newmodel():
    return MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,),alpha=1e-3,max_iter=500,random_state=0)
plain=newmodel().fit(X_fit,y_fit);aug=newmodel().fit(np.vstack([X_fit,shift_right(X_fit)]),np.hstack([y_fit,y_fit]))
sv=shift_right(X_val);pp=plain.predict_proba(sv);pv=pp.argmax(axis=1)
acc_shift=round(float((pv==y_val).mean()),3);acc_aug=round(float(aug.score(sv,y_val)),3);defense="augment" if acc_aug>acc_shift else "plain"
example_idx=int(np.flatnonzero((pv!=y_val)&(pp.max(axis=1)>=.9))[0])
plt.imshow(sv[example_idx].reshape(8,8),cmap="gray_r");plt.title(f"truth={y_val[example_idx]}; prediction={pv[example_idx]}; p={pp[example_idx].max():.3f}");plt.show()
final=newmodel()
if defense=="augment": final.fit(np.vstack([X_train,shift_right(X_train)]),np.hstack([y_train,y_train]))
else: final.fit(X_train,y_train)
left=np.roll(X_test.reshape(-1,8,8),-1,axis=2);left[:,:,-1]=0
holdout_accuracy=round(float(final.score(left.reshape(-1,64),y_test)),3)
print("Защита выбрана на правом сдвиге; перенос на левый измерен отдельно:",holdout_accuracy)
expect: Q1 решить shift. Q2 опора: формула и заготовка этого урока. Q3 augment поможет вправо,не гарантирую влево; пример покажу,не описываю до просмотра.
